geometric_means: G_C, G_L, and G_R are geometric means of the observed positive metric over the fixed center, left-shoulder, and right-shoulder alpha sets.
roughness: R = median(Delta x)^2 * RMS(kappa_i - mean(kappa)) over 0.3 <= alpha <= 3. R=0 when fewer than two kappa values are available; missing local points remain penalized through q.
completion: q = number of budget-reached positive values divided by the 19 preregistered alpha values.
component_score: S = A - lambda_R * R - lambda_1:10 * R_1:10 - lambda_M * (1-q). If a center or shoulder geometric mean is unavailable, A is set to 0 and the missing-data penalty remains active.
aggregate_score: Arithmetic mean of S over the two metrics and all four budgets. Because S is in log units, this is equivalent to geometric aggregation of the underlying advantage ratios.
midrange_diagnostic: On 1 <= alpha <= 10, report adjacent nonuniform log-alpha second differences, log slopes, peak/well turn counts, total curvature RMS, and negative-curvature RMS.
midrange_roughness: R_1:10 = median(Delta x)^2 * RMS(kappa_i - mean(kappa)) on 1 <= alpha <= 10.
missing_weight_interpretation: lambda_M = ln(10): a completely missing component receives a one-decade penalty before other terms.
endpoint_policy: Input rows must use the last real N_F <= B only after the run has genuinely reached B; no terminal carry-forward is allowed.
selection_policy: Rank caps by aggregate_well_score. Report all component scores, minimum component score, completion, and penalties; do not replace missing values or tune weights after viewing cap25/30. A rank is labelled final only when all 19 alpha runs for that cap are represented in the source CSV; otherwise it is explicitly provisional.
endpoint_trailing_consistency_rule: At each cap and budget: at least 8 overlapping alpha values; Spearman rank correlation >= 0.80; endpoint and trailing minimum alphas differ by at most a factor of 2; and the signs of their center-vs-shoulder conservative advantages agree.
